_comment: KEY HYGIENE 2026-08-06: pitfall_index moved 0 -> 90 (the documented >=90 sentinel convention, in use on all nine backends) because this fixture and iga_surface_condition_naming both fell back to kratos::iga::0 and a shared runner key marks BOTH results failed. iga_surface_condition_naming keeps index 0 as the owner of that claim; this one probes the same registry facts from the other side and now reports under its own key. Nothing about what the fixture runs or expects changed. --- Tier-2: 'SurfaceLoadCondition' (bare) is not registered; the suffixed SurfaceLoadCondition3D3N/3D4N come from StructuralMechanicsApplication, and IGA's own surface-integration condition is SurfaceCondition3D3N (no 'Load'). Pitfall (kratos.iga #0). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The bare name raises RuntimeError 'The Condition "SurfaceLoadCondition" is not registered!'; all three suffixed spellings construct. Complements the existing iga_surface_condition_naming fixture by pinning the Load-vs-no-Load distinction the claim also makes. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 INVERTS the expected registration status of all 4 entities -- it claims the opposite of what this build registers, while still really calling CreateNewElement/CreateNewCondition for each name. Every registered[...] line then disagrees with itself and registry_mismatches goes from 0 to 4. This proves the booleans come from a real registry lookup on this build and that a wrong claim is caught. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all 4 registered[<name>]=<got>_expected=<must> lines, registry_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/iga_surfaceload_vs_surface_condition && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
